name: mri_cnn
description: DenseNet-121 fine-tuned on the Kaggle Brain Tumor MRI Dataset (masoudnickparvar, 7,023 images). Classifies axial MRI slices into 4 categories: glioma, meningioma, no-tumor, and pituitary adenoma.

training.note: WARNING: 'notumor' class comes from a different image source. Check domain_bias_report.json for brightness statistics.
